title: Tutor Parent Lead Microfunnel
oneLiner: A local tutoring lead cockpit for turning parent-group chatter into consults, trial lessons, and proof packets.
stitchPrompt: Create a responsive web app prototype called "Tutor Parent Lead Microfunnel" for independent tutors and small tutoring studios. The app should help tutors map local parent groups, neighborhood channels, school-specific communities, Google Business signals, and referral sources, then turn parent pain language into consults and trial lessons. Required sections: local channel map, parent pain keyword inbox, lead quality scorecard, reply and DM composer, trial lesson slot board, proof packet builder, consult follow-up tracker, and cost per booked consult strip. Use realistic tutoring sample data such as algebra panic, SAT prep, writing support, and parent Facebook group leads. Design direction: use the `financial-analyst` profile with clean performance metrics, disciplined comparison tables, restrained trust colors, and calm lead economics that make tutoring growth feel measurable rather than desperate.
